h1: Tube end deburring machine — pipe and tube ends deburred inside and outside in one cycle
intro: A tube end deburring machine (pipe end deburring machine) takes the burr off the cut end of a tube or pipe — inside and outside — after the saw, the tube cutter or the laser, so the end is safe to handle, slides cleanly into a fitting or a joint and takes paint or plating evenly. NovoTech sells the Eurofintec 143, built in Parma, Italy, by Gecam: the tube end goes into an adjustable central prism against a Ø9-13/16 × 3-15/16″ wire brush that turns while its own axis rotates, changing direction so every edge is deburred evenly — the inside and the outside of the end in one cycle, on stainless tube and profiles, round Ø13/16″ to Ø4-3/4″ and square 13/16″ to 4-3/4″, cut at 90° or 45°, and on bent parts too. Two brush speeds and two speeds of the brush-axis rotation. Supplied with a CSA-approved panel, installed and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

faq.q: What does a tube end deburring machine do?
faq.a: It removes the burr that the saw, the tube cutter or the laser leaves on the cut end of a tube or pipe, on the inside and the outside edge, so the end is safe to handle, fits into a fitting or a joint and welds, paints and plates cleanly. On the 143 the end is pushed against a wire brush that turns while its own axis rotates, so both edges are deburred evenly in one cycle.

faq.q: Which tube sizes and cuts does the 143 take?
faq.a: Round tube from Ø13/16″ to Ø4-3/4″ (20 – 120 mm) and square tube from 13/16″ to 4-3/4″, with ends cut at 90° or 45°, and bent parts too. The adjustable central prism at the entry centres the tube at the brush.

faq.q: How are cut tube ends deburred on the 143?
faq.a: The tube end is pushed into a prism against a wire brush that turns while its own axis rotates and changes direction, deburring the inside and the outside of the end in one cycle. Two brush speeds and two speeds of the axis rotation set the action for the material and the burr.

faq.q: Does it polish the tube as well?
faq.a: No — the 143 works the cut end only. To clean, satin-finish or polish the length of the tube, see the pipe sanding and polishing machines: the BT 114-S, the 141 and 144 orbital sanders, the 128 centreless sanders and the 728 tube brushing machine.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models whose main motor is 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less — a machine with a motor above 2.2 kW must run on three-phase power and cannot be converted to 240 V single-phase. Manual machines have no electrics.

origin_feature.title: Made in Italy by Gecam
origin_feature.text: Gecam designs and builds deburring, grinding and finishing machines at Vicofertile, Parma — 100 % made in Italy, with components from Italian suppliers within 125 miles (200 km) of the plant. In 2005 it took over Eurofintec, the abrasive-belt machine builder whose name its pipe and belt machines still carry.
